During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''sympathizer''' assisted an [[Unidentified Alliance ambassador|Alliance ambassador]] during a meeting with the [[Gaddrian ambassador]] aboard the ''[[Silver Star]]''. The sympathizer was a member of an influential [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house.<ref name="Luxury" />
